production_baseline.state: Build 022 is a release candidate on agent/build022-freshness-usability; production GitHub Pages remains on main until merge and hosted acceptance.

release_candidate.release_boundary: Council/calendar/entity/lifecycle refresh is validated. Live procurement freshness is review-candidate evidence only and was not published.

metadata.purpose: Track current-public-source freshness without converting an unverified publication gap or transport failure into zero, overwriting historical provenance with replacement URLs, or promoting procurement/approval evidence into payment facts.

status_semantics.verified_current: An authoritative source for the latest currently applicable checked period is represented in the release candidate.
status_semantics.verified_new_source: New authoritative source records were verified but are intentionally held outside the release candidate pending a separate controlled normalization/reconciliation release.
status_semantics.not_yet_verified: A newer authoritative source has not been verified into the release. This is not evidence that it does not exist.
status_semantics.current_source_research: Current source discovery or comparison was performed; publication timing and evidence semantics still govern release.
status_semantics.source_transport_blocked: The registered checked evidence remains validated, but live source reproduction is blocked from the GitHub Actions runner. This is a transport state, not a zero or source-absence conclusion.

controlled_release_refresh.permissions: contents: write on release branch only
controlled_release_refresh.note: Publication requires Council decision validation, entity/lifecycle regeneration, exact delta review, Build 022 pinned controls and established contract validation.

read_only_domain_monitor.failure_isolation: Seven independent jobs; no domain depends on another domain succeeding.

read_only_domain_monitor.note: The monitor validates checked evidence and current source reachability/discovery. It does not auto-publish new procurement rows, infer missing values, or convert approvals/awards into payments.
